user.title: FordPass China
user.description: Choose an authentication method. Direct username/password auth has been disabled by Ford China; prefer the refresh_token captured from the FordPass app (auto-refreshed by the integration).

token.title: Authenticate with refresh_token
token.description: Paste the refresh_token captured from the FordPass app. See README for how to obtain it.

account.title: Authenticate with account/password
account.description: Note: Ford China changed the auth endpoints several times; this method may not work. Use refresh_token if it fails.

error.cant_auth: Failed to exchange refresh_token: token invalid or expired, please capture a new one
error.cant_login: Account login failed: auth rejected (use refresh_token instead)

init.title: FordPass China options
init.description: Set the vehicle status polling interval (minutes). Note: too-frequent polling may trigger Ford risk control.
